header: No heating, no water, a cold store warming up?
text: Answered every day of the year, including nights and public holidays. A technician calls back within 30 minutes; if the plant is under a maintenance contract, one is on the way inside four hours.
note: Call-outs outside 07:00 to 17:00 on working days carry a surcharge, which is quoted on the phone before anybody sets off. The number is free from Austrian networks.
